newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan's Hub Power up 1.95 pct.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan's Hub Power up 1.95 pct.

text.p: Pakistan's blue chip Hub Power Company shares jumped 1.10 rupees, or 1.95 percent, to 57.50 on Wednesday on hopes of higher corporate profits in fiscal 1996/97 (July-June), dealers said.
A turnover of over 8.0 million shares of Hub Power was recorded at the Karachi Stock Exchange in early trade.
"Hub Power will announce its results for the first time after today's board meeting," dealer Shakil Anwar said. "The market expects the company to announce good profits."
Hub Power, whose financial year ends in June, was listed on the Karachi bourse in 1994.
Anwar said the market was expecting an interim dividend, even though Hub Power said earlier it would give its first dividend in 1998.
Hub Power's $1.571 billion 1,292-megawatt power plant is the largest in Pakistan.
